__doc: Per-model floors for the repo-instructions gate: violation sites reported with the setting on.
Calibrate from two full runs of one commit (evals/AGENTS.md, "Floors and judges"); never copy these numbers elsewhere.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model): calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs of 5b6aeff14 (index + readRepoInstruction, quote check after verify), 29 and 25 of 43 sites. Noise from the paired per-case difference: sd of the difference of totals = sqrt(sum d^2) over the 14 cases, one run's sd = that / sqrt(2) / 43. floor = mean - 2 run sd, rounded down to 2 decimals. Both runs: no decoy hits, every instruction finding cited, and no repo_instruction finding with the setting off.
medusa#15810 (no-console) scored 0 of 4 in both runs and on the version that inlined the files, with no instruction finding at all: the model does not report it, not a lost read.
RATCHET: a PR that adds cases or moves the value on purpose recalibrates here in the same PR, with its runs as evidence.
